testcase.name: a good call is recorded once with IDs, outcome, status and latency only
the same idempotency token is used on every attempt of one call
retries with exponential back-off and logs every attempt; exhaustion is 503 integration.vendor_unavailable
a vendor 4xx is not retried, is 502 integration.vendor_rejected and does not count against the circuit
a timeout is enforced, aborts the adapter signal, and is logged as timeout
after the circuit opens, a call fails fast: adapter not called, attempt logged as rejected/circuit_open
disabled connection: refused before it leaves and logged as rejected/disabled
no connection row: fails without calling anything; no adapter installed: rejected/no_adapter
a vendor without an idempotency token gets a pending row first; after a timeout the vendor is asked before a repeat (34.3)
a failed log write after a successful call does not undo it and is reported
unknown kind, unknown operation and bad correlation are refused before anything happens
an adapter exception with a vendor message never leaks into the error or the log
opens after 5 consecutive failures, and not after 4
a success resets the consecutive count
opens at 50 % errors over 20 calls inside one minute
49 % over 20 calls stays closed; 19 calls are not enough to judge
calls older than a minute leave the window
half-open after 30 s admits exactly one probe; success closes
a failed probe re-opens for another 30 s
a released probe slot (vendor 4xx) lets the next call probe
state is per connection
the six R1 kinds each have an operation list, and the registry refuses duplicates and unknown kinds
is length-prefixed, versioned and stable; the challenge is its SHA-256
a different value, nonce or request ID changes the fingerprint; the value itself is not in the bytes
first failed probe degrades, the second in a row is down; a good probe restores
a passing probe with >= 50 % failures over >= 5 recent calls is degraded
